$description: AIFS dark surfaces: overrides Telekom's dark background and hairline steps so dark mode matches the darkness and blue-grey tint of the live docs. Text, link, action, tag and status colours stay Telekom's. Text: only the link and small-magenta text steps move, one step lighter on Telekom's scales, to keep AA on the new surfaces.

canvas.$description: Page, content sheet and header. Live docs page background (--sl-color-bg, hsl(224 10% 10%)). Dark-mode backgrounds of the live docs at docs.llmhub.t-systems.net (Starlight --sl-color-* computed in dark mode, 2026-10-31), which Andrej prefers over Telekom's near-black.

surface.$description: Sidebar and cards. Live docs header and sidebar (--sl-color-bg-nav, hsl(224 14% 16%)).

surface-subtle.$description: Inline code, table heads; mixed into the layout backdrop. Live docs inline code background (--sl-color-gray-5, hsl(224 10% 23%)).

faint.$description: Hairlines and card borders. Live docs card border (--sl-color-hairline-light, hsl(224 10% 23%)).

standard.$description: One step lighter on Telekom's own scale so text stays at WCAG AA (4.5:1) on the lighter dark surfaces above: the old value measured 4.17:1 (#7d94f9) on inline code in links and table heads (#353841); now 6.3:1.

hovered.$description: Stays lighter than the standard link.

visited.$description: One step lighter on Telekom's own scale so text stays at WCAG AA (4.5:1) on the lighter dark surfaces above: the old value measured below 4.5:1 (#9a75f8) on #353841; now 4.7:1.

standard.$description: One step lighter on Telekom's own scale so text stays at WCAG AA (4.5:1) on the lighter dark surfaces above: the old value measured 3.87:1 (#f61488) for the current sidebar entry on the sidebar (#23262f); now 4.7:1.
